reporting-org.narrative: The Global Fund to Fight AIDS, Tuberculosis and Malaria

title.narrative: Integrated HIV/AIDS and TB response in Guinea-Bissau - Guinea-Bissau (01-Jan-2024-31-Dec-2026)

description.narrative: Guinea-Bissau, TB/HIV, Ministry of Health of the Republic of Guinea-Bissau (MINSAP)This program has the following goals: Réduire de 15% du taux de l’incidence (par rapport à 2021) de la tuberculose d'ici 2026 // Reduce the incidence of tuberculosis by 15% (compared with 2021) by 2026. Réduire de 14% du nombre de décès dus à la TB (par rapport à 2021) d'ici 2026 // Reduce the number of TB deaths by 14% (compared with 2021) by 2026. Réduction de nouvelles infections du VIH et des IST de 1220 en 2022 à 788 en 2026 // Reduction in new HIV and STI infections from 1,220 in 2022 to 788 in 2026. Réduction de la transmission verticale du VIH de 22,08% en 2022 à 16,56% en 2026 // Reduction in vertical transmission of HIV from 22.08% in 2022 to 16.56% in 2026.. Réduction de la mortalité due au sida de 1448 en 2022 à 919 en 2026.// Reduction in AIDS-related mortality from 1,448 in 2022 to 919 in 2026.. The objectives of this program are: Augmenter la couverture de traitement des nouveaux cas de tuberculose sensible de 47,18% cas en 2021 à 62,45% cas en 2026 // Increase treatment coverage for new cases of susceptible tuberculosis from 47.18% in 2021 to 62.45% in 2026. Augmenter le taux de succès thérapeutique de 65% en 2022 à 75% en 2026 pour la TB-MR et/ou TB-RR. // Increase the therapeutic success rate from 65% in 2022 to 75% in 2026 for MDR-TB and/or RR-TB.. D'ici 2026, 83,33% des personnes vivant avec le VIH connaissent leur état sérologique. // By 2026, 83.33% of people living with HIV will know their serostatus. D'ici 2026, 95 % des personnes sous traitement ont une charge virale indétectable. // D'ici 2026, 95 % des personnes sous traitement ont une charge virale indétectable.

title.narrative: Coverage / Output indicators targets and results for GNB-C-MOHP03
Percentage of people with confirmed RR-TB and/or MDR-TB that began second-line treatment
Percentage of people who inject drugs reached with HIV prevention programs - defined package of services
Percentage of HIV-exposed infants receiving a virological test for HIV within 2 months of birth
Number of patients with of all forms of TB notified (i.e., bacteriologically confirmed + clinically diagnosed); *includes only those with new and relapse TB
Number of people with confirmed RR-TB and/or MDR-TB notified
Percentage of men who have sex with men reached with HIV prevention programs - defined package of services
Percentage of sex workers reached with HIV prevention programs - defined package of services
Number of people in contact with TB patients who began preventive therapy
Percentage of pregnant women who know their HIV status
Percentage of pregnant women living with HIV who received antiretroviral medicine to reduce the risk of vertical transmission of HIV
Percentage of people living with HIV currently enrolled on antiretroviral therapy who started TB preventive treatment (TPT) during the reporting period
Treatment success rate of RR-TB and/or MDR-TB: Percentage of patients with RR and/or MDR-TB successfully treated
Percentage of children (under 15) on ART among all children living with HIV at the end of the reporting period
Percentage of HIV-positive new and relapse TB patients on ART during TB treatment
Percentage of adults (15 and above) on ART among all adults living with HIV at the end of the reporting period
Timeliness of reporting: Percentage of submitted monthly reports (for the reporting period) that are received on time per the national guidelines

Treatment success rate- all forms: Percentage of patients with all forms of TB, bacteriologically confirmed plus clinically diagnosed, successfully treated (cured plus treatment completed) among all TB patients notified during a specified period; *includes only those with new and relapse TB
Percentage of new and relapse TB patients tested using WHO recommended rapid diagnostic tests at the time of diagnosis
Percentage of registered new and relapse TB patients with documented HIV status
Percentage of laboratories successfully participating in external quality assurance (EQA) or proficiency testing (PT) schemes
